findings.issue: Compiler error CS1503: `item` is of type `ISymbol` (it can be a field or property), but `GetPropertyIdentifierLocation` expects an `IPropertySymbol`. This will break the build.

`GetPropertyIdentifierLocation` uses `as PropertyDeclarationSyntax`, which evaluates to `null` for record properties (`ParameterSyntax`) and fields (`VariableDeclaratorSyntax`). This causes the `BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull` diagnostic to be silently dropped for these source-declared members, violating REQ-2283-NF1.

`ReportIfLocatedInCompilation` uses `||` instead of `&&`. For project references, `IsInSource` is true but the syntax tree belongs to another compilation. This causes the analyzer to attempt reporting diagnostics against external syntax trees, crashing with `ArgumentException` and violating REQ-2283-F1.
